WorkAssignmentProposal revision, freeze, submit, escalation, rejection, supersession, integrity and staleness checks.

locked_invariants: PM remains a proposal/decomposition/escalation role and is not semantic, scientific, governance, or execution authority.
GWF remains governance authorization and durable runtime authority.
P4 does not redefine the P1 WorkAssignment object or lifecycle.
A submitted proposal revision is content-bound and cannot be silently mutated.
A materially stale governed-state revision cannot authorize materialization.
One exact P4 proposal revision materializes to at most one authorized WorkAssignment.
Every P4-derived authorized WorkAssignment is bound to exactly one source proposal revision.
Provider/model difference alone cannot establish QA independence.
Protected-resource payload is not exposed to PM and protected access requires separate authorization.
HumanActionRequest cannot be bypassed or self-resolved by PM.
P1, P2 and P3 execution-lock artifacts and implementation blobs remain unchanged.
explicitly_not_authorized: ChatGPT App or model-specific PM runtime binding
scientific evidence admission or adjudication by PM
